title: Mai kinte teer nikalu
body:
lipat ke shaah se kehti hai fatema ro ke
mere hussain mai kitne teer nikaloo tumko chain milay
<<DIVIDER>>
bata hussain zyada hai dard kis jaa par
ke maa nikaal le wo teer ya ali keh kar
tadapna dekha nahi jaata ab to maadar se
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis ko pyar se athara saal paala hai
usi ke seene pe zaalim ne naiza maara hai
jawan ke seene se khaynchi hai khud sina tune
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na haath pehlu se utha na tham sake aansoo
tumhe to yaad hai zakhmi huwa mera pehlu
chupa na paoge pehlu ka dard ab maa se
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhe rakha hai sada apni cha'on may maine
bala ki dhoop hai maqtal may ay mere bache
tumhari laash pe saaya karoongi baalon se
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaza ne tujhse mujhe kamsini may cheen liya
zamana hogaya tujhse milay huwe beta
lagaloo phir tujhe seene to mujhko chain milay
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
naseeb tak na huwa jalti khaak ka bistar
damay akheer tumhara badan hai teeron par
tumhe ye teer tadapne talak nahi dete
mere hussain mai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain bolay mubarak ye maa se rote huwe
ay maa nikaal lo bas teer mere pehlu se
jabeen ho sajde may jis waqt mera dum nikle
mere hussain mai...
author: Mubarak
